snippet.title: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive - Game Trailer. Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads.
Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice. 
But remember, no matter what you scream, the wheel is still in her hands!

Wishlist Now!

- Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3948460/_/
- Discord : https://discord.gg/FGKPcydtty
